# Task

`schemas/records/task.json`

The payload of task.created/v1 (M1 slice plan P3; D51): a task put in its project's Ready backlog, at most five per project. Creation is not admission. spec is the task.create scope as sent and spec_digest its content digest (RFC 8785), which an operator's create approves in the same command (approval.recorded/v1, proposal null, policy none). acceptance lists the spec's attachments, each classed restricted and withheld from builder and reviewer.

| `created_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

## Definitions

### AcceptanceBlob

An acceptance test: overlaid on the gate workspace only, never an input of a build or a review.

#### Fields of AcceptanceBlob

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | [AcceptancePath](api-scope-task-create.md#acceptancepath) |  |
| `digest` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) |  |
| `class` | yes | one of `restricted` |  |
| `withheld_from` | yes | array of one of `builder`, `reviewer` (minItems `2`, maxItems `2`, unique items) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
